title: Show admin wallet balance on the index (home) balance widget for admin users

requirements.text: Update the global BalanceIndicator so that when the signed-in user is an admin, the UI also shows the Admin Wallet Balance (in PKR) in the same fixed balance widget shown on the index/home page (and wherever BalanceIndicator is rendered), without changing the existing behavior for non-admin users.

quotes: Is ko bi balance index ma add kar do ... SELECT balance FROM admin WHERE id=1 ...

acceptanceCriteria: When viewing the Home (index) page as a non-admin authenticated user, the BalanceIndicator continues to show only the caller balance and does not display any admin wallet information.
When viewing the Home (index) page as an unauthenticated user, the BalanceIndicator continues to show a default balance of 0 PKR and does not display any admin wallet information.
When viewing the Home (index) page as an admin user, the BalanceIndicator displays both (a) the caller balance and (b) an additional clearly labeled 'Admin Wallet' balance value in PKR.
All user-facing labels used for the admin wallet display are in English.

requirements.text: Prevent unauthorized admin-wallet lookups from breaking the BalanceIndicator UI: the app must not surface an error state in BalanceIndicator for non-admin users due to calling the admin-wallet API; instead, it should treat admin-wallet data as unavailable and simply not render the admin-wallet portion of the UI.
acceptanceCriteria: On a non-admin account, the BalanceIndicator renders normally and does not show an error message related to admin wallet authorization.
On an admin account, the BalanceIndicator successfully fetches and renders the admin wallet balance.
If the admin wallet fetch fails for any reason (network/actor not ready), the BalanceIndicator still renders the caller balance and the page remains usable.

requirements.text: Ensure the displayed Admin Wallet balance in the BalanceIndicator reflects backend state (Motoko adminWallet): after a successful admin-to-user distribution, the Admin Wallet balance shown in the UI updates without requiring a full page refresh.

quotes: UPDATE admin SET balance = balance - $initialBalance WHERE id=1

acceptanceCriteria: After completing an admin distribution flow in the app, the Admin Wallet balance shown in the fixed balance widget updates to the new value without a full page reload.
The admin wallet balance displayed matches the value returned by the backend getAdminWalletBalance API (no frontend-only/admin-local balance source).

constraints: Do not modify files under frontend/src/components/ui (read-only UI components).
Respect the existing single-actor Motoko backend architecture; do not add additional backend services.
Use English for any user-facing text.
nonGoals: Do not add any SQL tables, MySQL logic, or PHP code to the project (the provided snippet is behavioral reference only).
Do not change the backend authorization model beyond what is necessary to safely display admin wallet balance to admins.
Do not implement any real TikTok API or external payment integration.

preferencesToAdd: Use English for any user-facing text.
